title: SN1 Battle of Braunschweig
content:
10:00 - 15:00 | [:smflag-gb:](../../Forces/United Kingdom/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Braunschweig](../../Maps/braunschweig/Braunschweig/)
The Third World War has begun, and Warsaw Pact armies are pouring across the Inner German Border. Elements of the famed 7th Armoured Brigade, along with recce troops from the British I Corps Screening Force, are tasked with slowing down the lead tanks of the Soviet 7th Guards Tank Division. The brigade has assigned a battlegroup based around the 2nd Royal Tank Regiment with the task of delaying any Soviet attack south of Braunschweig. **_Scenario by David Whitt | Map by Scott Gibbs_**

title: SN2 Fancy Meeting You Here
content:
19:00 - 01:00 | [:smflag-gb:](../../Forces/United Kingdom/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Holle](../../Maps/holle/Holle/)
July 20, 1985 - British vs Soviet forces While the 2nd Royal Tank Regiment is delaying around Wolfenbuttel, the remainder of the brigade is hastily ordered to the Holle area. 12 Armoured Bde normally assaigned that sector have not arrived. It is feared elements of the Soviet 10th Guards Tank Division are racing to secure the vital road junction. **_Scenario by David Whitt | Map by Scott Gibbs_**

title: SN3 The Ghost of Arminius
content:
03:00 - 11:00 | [:smflag-gb:](../../Forces/United Kingdom/) vs [:smflag-pl:](../../Forces/Poland/) | @ [Bielefeld](../../Maps/bielefeld/Bielefeld/)
The Warsaw Pact forces have pushed west from their Weser River crossing sites - their main axis running from Bad Oeynhausen towards Münster. A supporting axis of the attack pushed southwest following the Autobahn 2 and highway B61 into the Bielefeld, Teutoburger Wald area. The Polish division is now engaged with a mix of NATO forces desperately trying to stem the advance. There has been little action east of Bielefeld; seeing an opportunity, NORTHAG orders the division to conduct a limited counterattack across the imposing Teutoburger Wald into the eastarn outskirts of Bielefeld. **_Scenario by David Whitt | Map by Richard Lloyd_**

title: SN4 Tea Time
content:
02:30 - 10:30 | [:smflag-gb:](../../Forces/United Kingdom/) vs [:smflag-su:](../../Forces/Soviet Union/) | @ [Unna](../../Maps/unna/Unna/)
The Warsaw Pact drive crossed the Teutoburg Wald at its western boundary, and rapidly advaced south towrads the Ruhr. NATO commanders are throwing all available reserves into trying to shore up the front lines. As part of that effort, the brigade is ordered to attack the vital road network around the city of Unna. Despite the grumblings of the troops promised their afternoon tea, the attack would commence on schedule. **_Scenario by David Whitt | Map by Scott Gibbs_**
